qs.q: Which parathyroid hormone-related condition is most often associated with a significantly increased risk of parathyroid carcinoma?
qs.e: HPT-JT syndrome, caused by CDC73 gene mutations, carries a substantially higher risk of parathyroid carcinoma (around 15%) compared to sporadic adenomas (<1%) or MEN1.
